scope: Human owner message -> actual systemd timer -> native Codex model -> installed skill -> disposable SQLite API -> reply + ack
checks: Timer exists and is active; the harness never invokes the service manually
Timer-triggered turn 1: native skill load, correct substantive reply and successful acknowledgment
Timer-triggered turn 2: native skill load, correct substantive reply and successful acknowledgment
rerun: npm run build:server && node --use-env-proxy scripts/verify-scheduled-check.mjs (Linux/systemd and authenticated Codex required; consumes model quota)
limits: Two real human-to-agent replies through an accelerated disposable timer. No permanent user-agent recurring tasks were created; those require configuration in their own host runtime.
